config.axiom_blueprint_items.title: Axiom Blueprint Items
config.axiom_blueprint_items.repeat.norm: Holding Shift + right-click places once per full hand swing (6 ticks).
config.axiom_blueprint_items.repeat.fast: Holding Shift + right-click places faster (4 ticks).
config.axiom_blueprint_items.repeat.slow: Holding Shift + right-click places once per second (20 ticks).
config.axiom_blueprint_items.air_only.de: Only place blueprint blocks in air. Existing blocks are preserved. Applies to movable and instant placement.
config.axiom_blueprint_items.static.desc: Show Axiom's saved thumbnail. Uses the fewest resources.
config.axiom_blueprint_items.lightweight: Show a simplified colored miniature at four frames per second. Uses fewer resources.
config.axiom_blueprint_items.high_qualit: Show a smoothly rotating preview with the blueprint's block models and textures. Uses the saved thumbnail while loading.
config.axiom_blueprint_items.save_failed: Could not save settings. Check the config file.
